correctness.rationale: The source defines a distinct-descendant incidence matrix from 128 binary 7-words to 32 binary 5-words, avoiding multiplicity overcount from coincident deletion patterns. Every certificate row supplies a codebook C_L and dual weights y_v>=0,z_w>=0 satisfying sum_{v in D(w)} y_v+z_w>=1 for all 128 source words, yielding the weak-dual bound |C|<=L sum_v y_v+sum_w z_w. In an independent BigInt rational computation directly from frozen certificates.json blob 2ae3d..., all 6×128 inequalities and all nonnegativity checks passed; all listed codebooks are distinct of sizes 5,11,16,21,26,32 and each of 32 received words obeys the list limit. Objectives were exactly 256/45, 666/59, 452/27, 1160/53, 1430/53 and 2340/73; each is strictly below the next integer. Thus lower and upper bounds coincide; a complete FINITE certificate covers the entire stated domain (not any longer block length).
residual_risks: Scope n=7 and L=1,...,6 only, not longer or nonbinary codes; no asymptotic theorem.
